containers.name: side

expected.why: a restartable init container (native sidecar) is stopped when the pod's regular containers have finished for good; this instance ended after the last of them (exit codes such as 143 or 137 are normal for that shutdown)

restart.detail: the pod is in the terminal phase Succeeded, so the kubelet no longer restarts its containers (restart policy Always)

verdicts.summary: API reported exitCode=137; by convention that is SIGKILL (128+9), but the API does not say what sent it
competing: the application called exit(137) itself; the API cannot distinguish that from death by SIGKILL
an OOM kill that the runtime did not label OOMKilled

evidence.note: convention only: the API signal field is shown only when the API set it

containers.logNote: the logs API returns no container ID: these lines are associated with the explained instance by position (previous or current container) and are an assumption
